description: Independent Breslow13 reference parameters transcribed from the reviewed contract; per-second rates are converted to per-hour.
notes: a_h = 0.0010422*3600 = 3.75192 pM/h (pinned source); the printed paper table gives 1.0442e-3 before conversion.
betaIP/betaCP/betaAP are per-second source rates multiplied by 3600.
beta is a per-minute Process L rate; dn/dt carries the source factor 60 (60*beta = 0.42 per hour).
K = 0.55 is inherited from Jewett99/Hilaire07 and is not a Breslow13 parameter.
phi_on - phi_off is ~1.761 rad but not exactly the literal 1.761.
exp(-600*1.761) underflows to 0.0 in float64, so the activation normalization is exactly 1.0.

phase.wrap: [-pi, pi) half-open; the source evaluates the branch on the wrapped atan2(x, xc) output

provenance: contract-derived analytic constants (not frozen implementation behavior); a disagreement with any implementation is adjudicated, never edited into this file.
